content.text:
I've read every changed file in full. This change is a pure UI refactor of the profile hub's Pro card and upgrade sheet:

- `app/profile/page.tsx` — only adds a static `icon` string field to a hardcoded `LINKS` const.
- `components/billing/pro-card.tsx` — new client component with a `useState` open/closed toggle; renders static copy and forwards `tier` to `UpgradeSheet`. No dynamic HTML, no external data.
- `components/billing/upgrade-sheet.tsx` — renders `title`/`body`/`isPro`/`onClose` props via ordinary JSX interpolation (React auto-escapes). Icons are imported statically from `lucide-react`. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no href/URL sinks, no server calls.
- `components/profile/profile-hub.tsx` — refactor: replaces inline pro-card markup with `<ProCard/>`, adds a static `ICONS` map keyed by `HubLink.icon` (constrained by TS to `keyof typeof ICONS`). Links use `href` from a static const in `page.tsx`.
- Test files — no runtime impact.

There are no attacker-controllable inputs reaching a sink, no authorization/tier decisions moved server-side (tier is still resolved via `entitlementsFor(profile?.tier)` on the RSC and only used for display copy — the UpgradeSheet has no purchase action and the card is inert by design). The `pieces` count query in `page.tsx` lacks a `user_id` filter, but that is pre-existing code outside the `+` lines of this diff, so per the instructions it is not flagged here.
